market_summary: All four assets (XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, BTCUSD) are exhibiting post-flush consolidations during the New York session, trading well below their respective session VWAP, EMA50, and Value Area Lows. Despite persistent bearish session CVD across the board, trading activity has dried up with RVOL below 1.0 on all pairs. Key session lows are holding as local support, producing quiet ranges without the volume spikes necessary to justify fresh momentum entries. Full discipline dictates HOLD across the entire portfolio until new directional liquidity is swept.

signals.rationale: Price at 3874.76 is trading below VAL (3902.66) and well below session POC (3978.13). CVD is -8.28 (BEARISH) with a negative slope of -0.21, aligning with the broader bearish trend. Timing is in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is trending firmly below downward-sloping VWAP (3937.16) and EMA50 (3921.21), remaining capped beneath the EMA20 baseline (3890.15). In the ATR envelope, candles are consolidating in the lower quadrant between EMA20 and the lower ATR band (3867.11). Volume is quiet with RVOL at 0.77 without yellow spike confirmation. Structural support sits at Session Low (3852.35). GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING with price hovering directly at the Gamma Flip level (3871.38) and well above Put Wall #1 (3819.97), favoring compression rather than immediate trend continuation.

Price at 1.10581 is positioned below VAL (1.10740) and below POC (1.10943). CVD is -4,328 (NEUTRAL) with a steep negative slope (-5,740.34). Current timing is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price remains suppressed below both falling VWAP (1.10806) and EMA50 (1.10796). Price is pressing against the lower ATR band (1.10542) while testing Session Low support at 1.10533. RVOL is subdued at 0.663 with no yellow spike confirmation across the last 15 bars, indicating a low-volume stall rather than an active breakout. Immediate resistance stands at S/R 1.10662. With price directly into support without breakout volume, the setup lacks edge.

Price at 1.32348 is trading below VAL (1.32521) and POC (1.32731). CVD is -8,718 (BEARISH) with a negative slope (-441.30), agreeing with the downtrend direction. Timing is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is structurally bearish below downward-sloping VWAP (1.32578) and EMA50 (1.32573). Candles are trading mid-channel between the lower ATR band (1.32276) and EMA20 (1.32470). Volume is depleted with RVOL at 0.469, far below the yellow spike threshold (15 bars since last spike). Price is hovering above Session Low (1.32210) while capped by S/R resistance at 1.32500. The absence of volume and mid-range consolidation warrant patience.

Price at 71738.60 is located below VAL (72276.48) and POC (73501.60). CVD is -0.08 (BEARISH) with a slightly negative slope (-0.01), reflecting steady sell pressure over the session. Current timing is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price sits well below descending VWAP (72850.20) and EMA50 (72603.16), with EMA20 (71975.68) acting as overhead dynamic resistance. Candles are consolidating inside the lower half of the ATR envelope above the lower band (71252.23). RVOL is neutral at 0.864 with no yellow breakout volume spike. Price holds above Session Low support (71141.00) following an earlier rejection, but lacks momentum to initiate a mean reversion or breakout.
